title: Depth 14 (dim 896, 14 heads of 64)
description: DEPTH 10->14 and HEAD_DIM 128->64 (n_embd 640->896, 14 heads), DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64->32 so grad_accum goes 2->4; TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE and all LRs unchanged.
reflection: Strong NEGATIVE: val_bpb 1.033433 vs 0.988076 baseline, +0.045 — ~64 sigma against the measured 7e-4 noise floor, so the depth axis turns over hard somewhere between 10 and 14. Throughput is NOT the confound: MFU came in at 43.38%, the highest in the cell so far (above a5's 41.9% at depth 10), so the grad_accum 2->4 handicap I flagged before the run never materialised. The model is simply starved: 200.9M params trained on 125.3M tokens in 478 steps, i.e. ~0.6 tokens per parameter, versus 85.9M params on 293M tokens (~3.4 tok/param) at depth 10. Reading depth 8 (~0.997 at 2^18) / 10 (0.988) / 14 (1.033) together, the curve is a shallow well with its floor at or just past depth 10, and the useful frame for future rounds is tokens-per-parameter under a fixed 5-minute budget, not depth as such. VRAM also came in at 34.4GB, exactly as projected from the n_layer*n_embd*device_batch scaling, so device batch 32 was the right call but device batch 64 would have needed ~66GB and was genuinely unsafe.
